customManagers.description: labrinth image for the e2e suite

packageRules.description: prod is a mutable tag whose digest updates carry no release timestamp, and an age gate would restart on every deploy
prBodyNotes: Re-check `seedDump` and `allScopes` in `e2e/images_test.go` against the new image's `org.opencontainers.image.revision` label, and update the revision noted there.

packageRules.description: the pinned SHA-256 has to follow the version
prBodyNotes: Update `serverStarterJarSha256` in `server/starter.go` to the SHA-256 of the new release's `server.jar`, or the install fails its hash check.
